# ERD 
## Sistem Magang AMIKOM

---

```

================================================================================
COPY DARI BAWAH INI
================================================================================

// =====================================================
// SISTEM MAGANG AMIKOM - Entity Relationship Diagram
// Database: PostgreSQL
// Generated by Tim noName - 2026
// =====================================================

// Tabel 1: users (Base Table)
Table users {
  id int [pk, increment]
  email varchar(255) [unique, not null]
  password_hash varchar(255) [not null]
  role varchar(20) [not null, note: "mahasiswa, dosen, admin, mitra"]
  created_at timestamp
  updated_at timestamp
}

// Tabel 2: mahasiswa (Profile - 1:1 dengan users)
Table mahasiswa {
  id int [pk, increment]
  user_id int [unique, not null]
  nim varchar(20) [unique, not null]
  nama varchar(255) [not null]
  ipk decimal(3,2) [note: "min 3.0 untuk bisa daftar magang"]
  semester int [note: "min 5 untuk bisa daftar magang"]
  no_telepon varchar(20)
  status_magang varchar(30) [default: "belum_magang"]
  created_at timestamp
}

// Tabel 3: dosen (Profile - 1:1 dengan users)
Table dosen {
  id int [pk, increment]
  user_id int [unique, not null]
  nidn varchar(20) [unique]
  nama varchar(255) [not null]
  email varchar(255)
  no_telepon varchar(20)
  created_at timestamp
}

// Tabel 4: admin_prodi (Profile - 1:1 dengan users)
Table admin_prodi {
  id int [pk, increment]
  user_id int [unique, not null]
  nama varchar(255) [not null]
  created_at timestamp
}

// Tabel 5: mitra (Profile - 1:1 dengan users)
Table mitra {
  id int [pk, increment]
  user_id int [unique, not null]
  nama_perusahaan varchar(255) [not null]
  alamat text
  pic_nama varchar(255)
  pic_email varchar(255)
  pic_telepon varchar(20)
  status varchar(20) [default: "pending", note: "pending, approved, rejected"]
  created_at timestamp
}

// Tabel 6: lowongan (Lowongan Magang)
Table lowongan {
  id int [pk, increment]
  mitra_id int
  posisi varchar(255) [not null]
  kuota int [default: 1]
  deskripsi_task text
  requirements text
  lokasi varchar(255)
  batas_daftar date
  status varchar(30) [default: "draft", note: "draft, menunggu_kurasi, published, ditolak, revisi"]
  created_by int
  created_at timestamp
  updated_at timestamp
}

// Tabel 7: pendaftaran (Pendaftaran Magang)
Table pendaftaran {
  id int [pk, increment]
  mahasiswa_id int [not null]
  lowongan_id int [not null]
  status varchar(30) [default: "pending_prodi", note: "pending_prodi → pending_mitra → diterima / ditolak"]
  alasan_penolakan text
  created_at timestamp
  updated_at timestamp
}

// Tabel 8: penugasan_dosen (Penugasan Dosen Pembimbing)
Table penugasan_dosen {
  id int [pk, increment]
  pendaftaran_id int [not null]
  dosen_id int [not null]
  assigned_by int
  assigned_at timestamp
  aktif boolean [default: true]
}

// Tabel 9: logbook (Laporan Bulanan)
Table logbook {
  id int [pk, increment]
  pendaftaran_id int [not null]
  mitra_id int
  dosen_id int
  periode_bulan date [not null]
  deskripsi_aktivitas text
  status_review varchar(30) [default: "draft", note: "draft, dikirim, dibaca, diterima, perlu_revisi"]
  feedback_supervisor text
  submitted_at timestamp
  reviewed_at timestamp
  created_at timestamp
  updated_at timestamp
}

// Tabel 10: logbook_task (Checklist Tugas Bulanan)
Table logbook_task {
  id int [pk, increment]
  logbook_id int [not null]
  deskripsi_task varchar(500) [not null]
  status varchar(20) [default: "pending", note: "pending, dikerjakan, selesai"]
  created_at timestamp
}

// Tabel 11: logbook_bukti (File Bukti Pekerjaan)
Table logbook_bukti {
  id int [pk, increment]
  logbook_id int [not null]
  file_path varchar(500) [not null]
  tipe varchar(20) [note: "foto, dokumen, pdf, jpg, png"]
  uploaded_at timestamp
}

// Tabel 12: notifikasi (Notifikasi User)
Table notifikasi {
  id int [pk, increment]
  user_id int [not null]
  tipe varchar(50) [note: "PENDAFTARAN_STATUS, LOGBOOK_DIBACA, LOGBOOK_DITERIMA, dll"]
  judul varchar(255) [not null]
  pesan text
  data_id int
  data_type varchar(50)
  is_read boolean [default: false]
  created_at timestamp
}

// Tabel 13: bookmark (Bookmark Lowongan)
Table bookmark {
  id int [pk, increment]
  mahasiswa_id int [not null]
  lowongan_id int [not null]
  created_at timestamp
}

// Tabel 14: pendaftaran_document (Dokumen Pendaftaran)
Table pendaftaran_document {
  id int [pk, increment]
  pendaftaran_id int [not null]
  tipe varchar(30) [note: "transkrip, cv, surat_lamaran, sertifikat, lainnya"]
  file_path varchar(500) [not null]
  uploaded_at timestamp
}

// Tabel 15: task_magang (Task Mingguan)
Table task_magang {
  id int [pk, increment]
  pendaftaran_id int [not null]
  deskripsi_task varchar(500) [not null]
  target_bulan date
  status varchar(20) [default: "pending", note: "pending, approved, completed"]
  created_at timestamp
}

// =====================================================
// RELASI (FOREIGN KEYS)
// =====================================================

// Profile tables → users (1:1)
Ref: mahasiswa.user_id > users.id
Ref: dosen.user_id > users.id
Ref: admin_prodi.user_id > users.id
Ref: mitra.user_id > users.id

// lowongan → mitra (N:1)
Ref: lowongan.mitra_id > mitra.id

// lowongan → users (N:1, created_by)
Ref: lowongan.created_by > users.id

// pendaftaran → mahasiswa (N:1)
Ref: pendaftaran.mahasiswa_id > mahasiswa.id

// pendaftaran → lowongan (N:1)
Ref: pendaftaran.lowongan_id > lowongan.id

// penugasan_dosen → pendaftaran (N:1)
Ref: penugasan_dosen.pendaftaran_id > pendaftaran.id

// penugasan_dosen → dosen (N:1)
Ref: penugasan_dosen.dosen_id > dosen.id

// penugasan_dosen → admin_prodi (N:1)
Ref: penugasan_dosen.assigned_by > admin_prodi.id

// logbook → pendaftaran (N:1)
Ref: logbook.pendaftaran_id > pendaftaran.id

// logbook → mitra (N:1, supervisor review)
Ref: logbook.mitra_id > mitra.id

// logbook → dosen (N:1, supervisor review)
Ref: logbook.dosen_id > dosen.id

// logbook_task → logbook (N:1)
Ref: logbook_task.logbook_id > logbook.id

// logbook_bukti → logbook (N:1)
Ref: logbook_bukti.logbook_id > logbook.id

// notifikasi → users (N:1)
Ref: notifikasi.user_id > users.id

// bookmark → mahasiswa (N:1)
Ref: bookmark.mahasiswa_id > mahasiswa.id

// bookmark → lowongan (N:1)
Ref: bookmark.lowongan_id > lowongan.id

// pendaftaran_document → pendaftaran (N:1)
Ref: pendaftaran_document.pendaftaran_id > pendaftaran.id

// task_magang → pendaftaran (N:1)
Ref: task_magang.pendaftaran_id > pendaftaran.id

================================================================================
SAMPAI SINI
================================================================================
```

### Step 4: Export

```
1. Klik tombol "Export" di pojok kanan atas
2. Pilih format:
   - PNG (untuk presentasi)
   - SVG (untuk editing di Figma)
   - PDF (untuk laporan)
3. Download!
```

### Step 5: Customization

```
ADD TABLE:
Table nama_table_baru {
  id int [pk]
  name varchar
}

ADD RELATION:
Ref: table_a.col_a > table_b.col_b

DELETE:
- Klik tabel/koneksi → Delete key
```

// VERSI SIMPLE - untuk presentasi ppt

}

}

}

  id int [pk]

  status varchar
}

  id int [pk]
  pendaftaran_id int

}

Table logbook {
  id int [pk]
  pendaftaran_id int
  status_review varchar
}

Table notifikasi {
  id int [pk]
  user_id int
  judul varchar
}

Table bookmark {
  id int [pk]
  mahasiswa_id int
  lowongan_id int
}

// Relations
Ref: mahasiswa.user_id > users.id
Ref: mitra.user_id > users.id
Ref: lowongan.mitra_id > mitra.id
Ref: pendaftaran.mahasiswa_id > mahasiswa.id
Ref: pendaftaran.lowongan_id > lowongan.id
Ref: penugasan_dosen.pendaftaran_id > pendaftaran.id
Ref: penugasan_dosen.dosen_id > dosen.id
Ref: logbook.pendaftaran_id > pendaftaran.id
Ref: notifikasi.user_id > users.id
Ref: bookmark.mahasiswa_id > mahasiswa.id
Ref: bookmark.lowongan_id > lowongan.id
